name: Deviation Edge Length Goal
description: Make the length of a deviation edge reach a target value.

inputParameters.name: edge_key
inputParameters.description: The key of a COMPAS CEM deviation edge.

inputParameters.name: weight
inputParameters.description: The weight of the goal in the optimization problem. Defaults to one.

outputParameters.name: goal
outputParameters.description: A COMPAS CEM deviation edge length goal.
